name: Default
shortDescription: Metaflow metadata service and web UI with PostgreSQL, tracking the flows, runs, steps and tasks that Metaflow clients record.

alerts.message: The UI and the metadata API have no built-in authentication: anyone with the URL can read run data and write metadata. Restrict access before recording real projects.

Point your Metaflow clients at the service with METAFLOW_SERVICE_URL=https://<your-domain>/metadata-service and METAFLOW_DEFAULT_METADATA=service. Logs, artifacts and DAGs appear in the UI only when flows use an S3 datastore that the metaflow-api service can read.
